name: The Grandfather Plane of Parco della Tesoriera

location.address: Parco della Tesoriera, Corso Francia, Torino

transport: Corso Francia, Pozzo Strada; tram 3 or 9, short walk into the park
verify_notes: The widest trunk on Turin's monumental tree register (665cm girth, 28m tall, 25m crown) and the tree most often called the city's oldest, nicknamed 'the grandfather' (il nonno). Stands alone in its own park, Parco della Tesoriera, about 3.6km from the other published Turin trees, so it opens a second Turin location rather than extending the existing walk. Age band on the register is over 200 years.

name: The Caucasian Elm of the Giardini Reali

location.address: Giardini Reali Inferiori, Piazza Castello, Torino

transport: Piazza Castello, central Torino; multiple tram and bus lines to Piazza Castello, short walk
verify_notes: A Caucasian elm designated for botanical rarity, standing in the Giardini Reali Inferiori (Lower Royal Gardens) beside the Palazzo Reale in the historic centre. Girth 350cm. Sources disagree on height: the register gives 24m, a tourist route guide gives 27m; state both rather than picking one. Age band on the register is 100 to 200 years.
